name: Chris
source:
The 13th head of Berntein Castle. He is a calm, collected perfectionist, and also a first-class magician. He sets out on a journey with Anduke to take revenge on the demons that killed his family and many of his fellow subjects.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071230090604fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/dangel/chara.html]Mink[/url]]
